notes:
Topline: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood as replacement for current LLM API provider (incumbent: OpenAI). Primary goal: move to Redwood Hosted quickly for parity testing, then transition to Dedicated for steady throughput and cost predictability.

Recent activities:
- 2026-01-18: Initial inbound via product demo signup. AE Olivia Chen assigned.
- 2026-02-02: Kickoff call (Fireflies ff_2026-02-02) w/ VP Eng (Samir Patel), Head of ML (Nadia Ortiz), Product PM (Leah Kim). Collected requirements + existing architecture notes.
- 2026-02-10: Hosted POC signed (2-week scoped evaluation). Provided Redwood quickstart + sample compat shim for OpenAI-style API. SE Marco Alvarez helping with integration.
- 2026-02-18: Mid-POC check-in (ff_2026-02-20). Ran baseline against incumbent on: median chat latency, token cost per session, embedding MRR throughput.
- 2026-02-25: Found prompt_parity drift for two system prompts (answer format differences, small hallucination regressions). Created eval suite "suite-infer-avenwood-v1" to capture prompt-level regressions.
- 2026-03-03: Security questionnaire submitted; infra team requires SAML + SOC2 evidence + KMS integration details. Legal asked for indemnity language and EU data residency options.

Technical summary / requirements:
- Workloads: primarily chat-based support assistant for customers (most traffic), plus semantic doc search (embeddings) and background reranking jobs.
- Latency/throughput targets: median latency <= 200ms per chat token (target 150ms), support peak 2.5k requests/minute across multi-tenant clusters.
- Cost sensitivity: looking for ~30% unit cost reduction vs incumbent via batching + quantization + caching; committed volume expected to be $150k-500k ARR if Dedicated pricing meets threshold.
- Model preferences: currently using an OpenAI-compatible chat model family; want compatibility layer/compat shim to minimize code churn. Need pinned model versions and fallback variants for availability.
- Parity/regression concerns: "VP Eng: can't accept >5% regression in core NLU accuracy or user satisfaction metric vs current provider" — requires automated evals and regression alerts tied to prompt suites.

POC notes / findings so far:
- Integration: Redwood hosted API accepted existing OpenAI-style calls with minor header changes using the provided shim. SDK drop-in looked clean.
- Prompt parity: two templates returned different JSON structure for table outputs; SE suggested prompt-engineering fixes and recommended Redwood's structured output + function-calling behavior test.
- Performance: hosted POC median latency measured ~180-220ms for target seq lengths; slightly slower for longer context. SE recommended batching + prefix KV caching to reduce token cost and improve tail latency.
- Cost: token accounting differs (tokenization differences); finance needs reconciled cost model before committing to Dedicated. Provided hosted usage export to compare.

Next steps (immediate):
- Deliver POC evaluation report (due 2026-03-12) with: perf numbers, prompt-regression heatmap, cost delta spreadsheet.
- Schedule Dedicated scoping call to outline reserved GPU pool, expected throughput, autoscale policy options (target week of 2026-03-15).
- Run cross-model parity tests across 50 canonical prompts in suite-infer-avenwood-v1; set up Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization and batching.
- Legal: push for draft SOW + sample indemnity wording; determine EU data residency pathway for customer subsets.

Quoted from call: "We need an apples-to-apples comparison — if moving to Redwood causes regressions in frontline support responses our CSAT drops and leadership will push back." — Samir Patel, VP Eng

Notes on migration path: plan is staged — 1) Hosted quick win to validate parity and run logged comparisons; 2) Dedicated pilot (1-2 month) for predictable throughput, routing and VPC isolation; 3) Full cutover with compat-layer adapters and a short rollback window. Track regressions with automatic alerts; require Redwood Optimize to propose quantization + batching configs to hit cost targets.

CRM misc: follow-up items added to Drive; SE tasks in INF-3147; legal thread in thread-1825-pricing-discuss-avenwood.
